title: 🌊FreshCatch🎣
description: Adds tons of new fish and planning to make new fishing rods
body:
This mod expands Minecraft’s fishing system by adding a wide variety of new fish that can be caught through normal fishing. New species include catfish, bass, sea bass, bluegill, and many additional freshwater and saltwater fish. Each fish is balanced and designed to fit naturally alongside vanilla content rather than replacing it.

All fish are obtained using standard fishing rods and the original fishing mechanics. No new systems are introduced, making the mod easy to use in both vanilla style worlds and large modpacks. The added fish provide more variety and long term enjoyment for players who like fishing, exploration, and collection.

Future updates will introduce stronger fishing rods that allow players to catch larger and rarer fish, adding progression while keeping compatibility with other mods in mind.

This mod is fully compatible with other mods that modify or overhaul fishing. It is ideal for players who enjoy Minecraft’s fishing but want more depth and variety without changing how the game fundamentally works.
